items.title: William "Big Bill" Thompson Interview, 1961-03-01
items.q: I know thousands of piano players, but I couldn't call all their names... And, like that old man, Pico that died there. Yeah. Old Alphonse Pico there. I remember him playing. But I was small when I heard him playing

ctx.x: No, no, no. No, no. No, no. No, no. No, no. No, no.

No. No. No. No. No. No. No. He was waking up on St. Charles Street there. I forget what number of the place now. He was waking up there on St. Charles Street up there at that time. Oh, I know thousands of piano players, but I couldn't call all their names. Yeah. But then they had, like, a long time. Before I started playing, there was hundreds of piano players around there and hundreds of musicians. And, like that old man, Pico that died there. Yeah. Old Alphonse Pico there. I remember him playing. But I was…
Do you remember who was the first one you ever heard play High Society, that clarinet part? Was it Pico or somebody else?
